## startup.jobs Category & Keyword Job Scraper

**Actor:** [startup.jobs Category & Keyword Job Scraper](https://apify.com/vexaloom-labs/startup-jobs-category-and-keyword-job-scraper)

**Docs:** https://github.com/bolvein-firex/scraping-n8n-workflows/blob/main/docs/startup-jobs-category-and-keyword-job-scraper.md

### Setup
1. Create an Apify account and copy an API token.
2. In n8n, create a **Query Auth** credential:
   - Name: `Apify API Token`
   - Query parameter name: `token`
   - Value: your Apify token
3. Open **Run Apify Actor** and select that credential.
4. Click **Execute workflow**. The rows appear in **Rows ready**.
5. Optional: enable **Google Sheets** and set your document and sheet.

### Notes
- This calls the public Actor endpoint. No API token is stored in this file.
- `run-sync-get-dataset-items` waits up to 300 seconds. For large runs, switch to the async run + dataset endpoint.
- Public data only. Respect the target site's terms and local law.

### Input fields
- `category` (string)
- `role` (string)
- `keyword` (string)
- `company` (string)
- `location` (string)
- `workplaceType` (string)
- `employmentType` (string)
- `experienceLevel` (string)
- `minSalaryUsd` (integer)
- `maxSalaryUsd` (integer)
- `postedWithin` (string)
- `maxItems` (integer)

### Output fields
- `title` (Title)
- `company` (Company)
- `location` (Location)
- `workplaceType` (Workplace Type)
- `salary` (Salary)
- `postedAt` (Posted At)
- `url` (Url)

description: startup.jobs category scraper: runs the startup.jobs Category & Keyword Job Scraper Apify Actor, returns title, company, location, salary, postedAt and more, then normalizes and dedupes the rows before an optional Google Sheets append.
